evals.prompt: I'm revising the hippocampus for an exam. Show me a coronal section with every structure labelled: the dentate gyrus and its layers, the CA fields and the strata of CA1, the subiculum, presubiculum, parasubiculum and entorhinal cortex, the alveus and fimbria, and the trisynaptic circuit. One HTML file I can open, light theme.
evals.expected_output: A single standalone light HTML page of a teaching model on a stand: a cast of the hippocampal formation with its coronal cut face toward the viewer, each region its own solid, each layer a band on its parent's face, one numbered pin per named part, a key under the card generated from a committed truth.mjs that has a source URL on every row, and a caption citing the source. The perforant path, mossy fibres, Schaffer collaterals and the subicular outputs are cords ending on synapse dots, and a pulse runs them in order on the idle tour with the readout naming each. Hovering a pin lifts and lights its part and writes its number and name; Q hides the names and click reveals one. The build asserts every truth row has a drawn region and a pin (checkTruth). The cut face was captured at 4x and every borders entry read as a shared edge beside the source's figure; every key name matches the source verbatim; the source was read a second time. node build.mjs --audit ends audit passed with 0 on every line, scripts/lines.mjs prints line ends: 0 on both themes, and 4x close-ups of every pin, border, layer band and cord end were taken and read.

evals.prompt: Make me a figure of a pyramidal neuron with the three glial cell types around it, with every part labelled so I can test myself: soma, dendrites, axon hillock, axon, myelin sheath, nodes of Ranvier, axon terminals, astrocyte, oligodendrocyte, microglia. Dark theme, standalone HTML.
evals.expected_output: A Figure (the response says so and estimates 30-90 minutes): a dark standalone page of a neuron on a stand with a truth.mjs listing the ten parts the user named verbatim, SOURCE.convention set to the user's list, and sources fetched only for borders and connections. The soma is a sphere or lathe, dendrites are routes that leave it tangent and branch at ball tees, the axon hillock tapers, the axon is one route with myelin collars gapping it and bare nodes between, terminals end on balls, and each glial cell is its own body whose processes end on something (the neuron, a collar, a capillary). One pin per part, a generated key, quiz mode working (Q hides names, click reveals). checkTruth passes, --audit ends audit passed, line ends: 0, 4x close-ups of every end and collar in both themes were read.

evals.prompt: For our teaching site, build the basal ganglia direct and indirect pathways on a coronal model: striatum, globus pallidus externa and interna, subthalamic nucleus, substantia nigra pars compacta and reticulata, and the thalamus. Show the signal running each pathway. A React component we can drop into our Next.js app, plus an HTML preview, dark theme.
evals.expected_output: A Hero (the response says so and gives the estimate). A truth.mjs with one row per nucleus and one PATHS row per link of the direct and indirect pathways in circuit order, each with its source URL. Geometry in plain modules, the static art in a server component with draw.tsx, one client component for the lift, the pulse and quiz mode, and a standalone dark HTML preview. Each nucleus is its own solid in a cutaway block, pins on every nucleus, the key generated from PARTS, the pulse runs the direct pathway then the indirect, naming each link in the readout. checkTruth passes, the preview's build reports audit passed and line ends: 0, 4x close-ups of every cord end and nucleus border were read, and the adjacency on the cut face was checked against the source's figure.

evals.prompt: Spinal cord cross-section with the stretch reflex arc. Use exactly these labels from my lecture, nothing else: dorsal horn, ventral horn, lateral horn, dorsal root, dorsal root ganglion, ventral root, dorsal column, lateral column, ventral column, central canal, grey commissure, muscle spindle, Ia afferent, alpha motor neuron. Light theme, one file.
evals.expected_output: A Hero. truth.mjs has exactly the fourteen names the user gave, in the user's order and spelling, SOURCE.convention records that they came from the user's lecture, and the caption says names follow it. Wikipedia was fetched only to fill borders (horns, columns, commissure and canal on the cut face) and the reflex arc's PATHS (spindle to Ia afferent to alpha motor neuron to muscle). The cord is a block with the transverse cut face toward the viewer, grey matter a tone darker than white, each horn and column its own solid, the roots and the arc as cords ending on synapse dots, one pin per label. The pulse runs the arc. checkTruth passes, audit passed, line ends: 0, 4x adjacency check done.

evals.prompt: Show me the whole human brain in mid-sagittal section with everything labelled, for revision.
evals.expected_output: The response sizes the request as an Epic before any work, gives the estimate (6 hours or more), proposes a Hero that keeps the core (for example the brainstem and diencephalon in mid-sagittal section: midbrain, pons, medulla, thalamus, hypothalamus, pituitary, pineal, corpus callosum's splenium, cerebellum as one body) with its own estimate, lists what the full version would add (every gyrus and sulcus of the medial surface, the ventricles, the meninges), and does not start building until the user chooses. If the user picks the Hero, it is built with the truth table, pins, key and anatomy check like every figure.
